title: Harder-task scan: where does single-phase generation plus rollout search fail?
hypothesis: Tasks needing tool use, insertion or multi-stage contact (assembly, hammer, shelf-place, basketball, sweep, soccer) expose failures of the single-phase + 24-candidate search recipe that the eight scanned tasks (D-019) did not, giving a task on which method variants can be compared.

prediction.against: the reach-v2 arm of R-022 (1.00 on its fresh confirmation cases)
prediction.rationale: At least one of the six harder tasks scores at least 0.20 below reach-v2 on 30 fresh cases after search; that task becomes the testbed for structure breadth (R-023's design) and for the two-lane pipeline.

code_changes: lares/core/obs_schema.py (register assembly-v2, hammer-v2, shelf-place-v2, basketball-v2, sweep-v2, soccer-v2 on the common V3 layout after check_against_env passes on the GPU box; open question: expose the second object block obs[11:18] as obj2 where the task has one)
lares/core/training_pipeline.py (TASK_DESCRIPTIONS for the six tasks, from MetaWorld's documentation; open question: or leave the env name as the description)

falsified_by: Every harder task scores less than 0.20 below reach-v2 after search; then the recipe saturates these tasks too and method comparisons need a stricter success criterion rather than new tasks.

cost_estimate.breakdown: 6 tasks x (24 x 5 probe + 30 confirmation) = 900; 6 single-phase calls + <= 6 corrections

controls.note: control is R-022's reach-v2 arm (1.00 on fresh confirmation, D-019), historical

result.notes: Six harder tasks registered on the V3 layout (hammer with a verified obj2 = nail); all schemas passed a simulator audit at reset and after one step (6 audit episodes) before any generation. Scan order assembly first. assembly-v2: single-phase gpt-6.1-sol structure (valid first time) + 24-candidate independent search: 0.00 on 30 fresh cases; the predeclared independent repeat (seeds 3320/3321) also 0.00. Both structures lift the nut (lift >= 2 cm on 16-18 of 24 candidates' probes) and move it toward the peg (best progress ~0.24), but no candidate ever seats it: the failure is the final precision placement. Per the protocol the scan stopped early; peg-insert-side, hammer, shelf-place, basketball and soccer were not run. 306 episodes (240 probe + 60 confirmation + 6 audit), 2 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: assembly-v2 scores 0.00 on 30 fresh cases after single-phase generation plus 24-candidate search, 1.00 below reach-v2, and the predeclared independent repeat (fresh generation and cases) also scores 0.00, so the weakness is reproducible rather than a low draw. The predicted >= 0.20 drop for at least one task holds. Mechanistically both structures grasp and lift the nut and carry it partway (progress ~0.24) but never seat it on the peg.
verdicts.next_experiment: Use assembly-v2 as the testbed: R-023's structure-breadth design (four structures x six candidates vs one x twenty-four), the two-lane pipeline with a fitted lane (needs an assembly demonstration buffer from the expert), and repair aimed at the final placement phase.
